title: CareQueue: Hospital OPD Tokens
context: Hospital out-patient departments issue tokens and display waiting times. Administrators decide how many doctors to schedule.
input: Arrivals per minute, consultation times, department tree.

milestones.title: Duplicate tokens
milestones.requirement: Token numbers issued twice by a faulty kiosk (count array).

milestones.title: Department totals
milestones.requirement: Patients per department in a nested department tree (post-order recursion).

milestones.title: Consultation capacity
milestones.requirement: Minimum patients per slot so the day’s patients, in arrival order, are seen within 5 slots.
